name: United Kingdom (England, Wales and Scotland)
disclaimer: General information about employment law in Great Britain to help you organise your record. It is not legal advice. Northern Ireland has separate laws and bodies. Time limits are strict, so get advice early.

lawyerHelp.label: Find a solicitor (Law Society) or free advice (Citizens Advice)

statutes.name: Equality Act 2010
statutes.summary: Protects against discrimination, harassment and victimisation because of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

agency.name: Acas early conciliation, then an employment tribunal

limitation.label: Start Acas early conciliation
limitation.note: Three months less one day from the incident, or from the last of a series of related acts. You must contact Acas before making a tribunal claim; doing so pauses the clock.

statutes.name: Employment Rights Act 1996 (Public Interest Disclosure Act 1998)
statutes.summary: Protects workers from being treated badly or dismissed for reporting wrongdoing in the public interest, such as danger to health and safety or breaking the law.

agency.name: Acas early conciliation, then an employment tribunal

limitation.label: Start Acas early conciliation
limitation.note: Three months less one day from the incident, or from the last of a series of related acts. You must contact Acas before making a tribunal claim; doing so pauses the clock.

statutes.name: Employment Rights Act 1996, unfair dismissal
statutes.summary: Protects employees from dismissal without a fair reason and process. Usually needs two years' service, but not for dismissals linked to whistleblowing, health and safety or pregnancy.

agency.name: Acas early conciliation, then an employment tribunal

limitation.label: Start Acas early conciliation
limitation.note: Three months less one day from the incident, or from the last of a series of related acts. You must contact Acas before making a tribunal claim; doing so pauses the clock.

statutes.name: Employment Rights Act 1996 Part II and National Minimum Wage Act 1998
statutes.summary: Protects against unlawful deductions from wages and pay below the national minimum wage.

agency.name: Acas early conciliation, then an employment tribunal

limitation.label: Start Acas early conciliation
limitation.note: Three months less one day from the deduction, or the last in a series of deductions.

statutes.name: Protection from Harassment Act 1997
statutes.summary: A course of conduct that causes alarm or distress can be a civil wrong and a crime, and employers can be responsible for harassment by employees.

agency.name: The civil courts, or the police

limitation.label: Bring a civil claim
limitation.note: Generally six years in England and Wales (Scotland differs).

statutes.name: Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 and ERA 1996 s.44
statutes.summary: Employers must keep workplaces safe. Employees who raise safety concerns are protected from detriment and dismissal.

limitation.label: Start Acas early conciliation
limitation.note: Three months less one day from the incident, or from the last of a series of related acts. You must contact Acas before making a tribunal claim; doing so pauses the clock.

statutes.name: Equality Act 2010, equality of terms
statutes.summary: Women and men are entitled to equal pay for equal work.

agency.name: Acas early conciliation, then an employment tribunal

limitation.label: Make an equal pay claim
limitation.note: Six months from the end of employment (or the end of the contract), not from each payslip.

support.name: Samaritans
support.description: Someone to talk to, day or night, free.

support.name: Acas helpline
support.description: Free, impartial advice on workplace rights.
